message.reasoning_content: Round 2 market. I have 2 goods, price ladder starts at index sold_counter=2 → price 9. Selling 2 units gets 9+8=17. But cash devaluation at round boundary 2+: wait, we're in round 2, border after round 2? "round boundaries 2+" — after round 2 cash floors to 62%. So selling now would devalue 62%. Better to use sell_credit: promissory ×1.25 added to cash after devaluation. So sell_credit 2 units → revenue (9+8)*1.25=21.25 as promissory, added at border after devaluation, no devaluation loss.
